title: dtmf.received
description: A touch tone the caller keyed. Written by the worker, one per tone, from the caller's own leg only: what a person keys is a fact of the call, whether an app reads it as a menu choice or the runtime reads four of them as the code a page is waiting for (call.claimed).

digit.description: The key, as printed on a phone.

code.description: RFC 4733's number for it: the digits are themselves, * is 10, # is 11.
